translation.about.title: ABOUT <1>ME</1>
translation.about.text:
Hello, welcome! 🖐🏻

My name is {{name}}, I live in {{city}}, I have a degree in Systems Analysis and Development and a postgraduate degree in Front-End.

I work as a Senior Full Stack Developer, but front-end is where I shine, and more specifically user experience. My specialty is building intuitive, helpful tools that solve the problem without making people think. I command the whole stack, which lets me see the system end to end, but I deliver my best by turning requirements into fluid, easy to use interfaces.

I've built applications for large operations like {{company}}. And off the keyboard, I'm an amateur volleyball player, bringing the same focus and teamwork from the court to the dev team.

translation.projects.title: Projects
translation.projects.pizra.title: Pizra Pizzeria
translation.projects.pizra.description: A fictional pizzeria website where I had my first solid experiences with responsiveness, blob animations, Google Maps integration and order routing to WhatsApp.
translation.projects.admin.title: Admin Dashboard
translation.projects.admin.description: Admin dashboard I created from scratch as the lead front-end developer, defining the visual identity, the UX patterns and the architecture of every screen. What you see here is a demo, the full version runs in production at the client.
translation.projects.admin.stat1.label: screens built from scratch
translation.projects.admin.stat2.label: in real production
translation.projects.admin.stat3.label: identity crafted by me
translation.projects.internal.title: Internal systems
translation.projects.internal.note: Most of what I build is closed source. I can't show the screens, but I can tell you where they run.
translation.projects.internal.caixa.description: Web applications for large customer-service operations of one of Latin America's biggest public banks.
translation.projects.internal.ambiensys.description: Where I work today: systems supporting waste-collection management for operations all across Brazil.
translation.projects.portfolio.title: This Portfolio
translation.projects.portfolio.description: Yes, this site is a project too: gooey cursor, 3D skills cloud, comets carrying techs into the projects, two themes and two languages. Open source, built to be as fun to explore as it was to build.
translation.projects.begin.title: Where I started
translation.projects.begin.note: Study projects from my early years, kept here fondly.
translation.projects.plansul.title: Recruitment Page
translation.projects.plansul.description: A real recruitment page I created for Plansul, where I consolidated what I learned in the pizzeria project. It went live and was used by the company to recruit telemarketing operators.
translation.projects.tinder.title: Interactive Tinder
translation.projects.tinder.description: A Tinder clone and one of my first projects. You can swipe the photos to react just like in the original. The phone is artwork I assembled div by div in HTML and CSS (from the buttons to the camera reflection). I made it as a junior and I'm very proud of it.
